subject: general
question: How many subjects are entitled and listed for the Panchayat in the Indian Constitution?
solution:
The correct answer is __**29**.__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The 73rd Constitution Amendment Act of 1992 added the 11th Schedule to the Indian Constitution. 29 subjects are on this programme.
 
• This schedule includes crucial subjects including the **authority of Panchayats, rural development, eradicating poverty, markets, roads, and clean water, among others.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• The following operational elements, which fall under the jurisdiction of the Panchayats, are listed in the eleventh schedule of the Indian Constitution:
 
 
• Agriculture, especially the expansion of agriculture
 
• Soil conservation, land reform implementation, land consolidation, and land enhancement.
 
• 3. Poultry, dairying, and animal husbandry
 
 
 
• It is expected that the subjects covered under the eleventh schedule of the Indian constitution are made to ensure the development of the rural India.
